about: Known failures of review-matrix.js, each with its reason in docs/todo.md (审阅模式, 2026-11-07): Enter or a paste of two lines inside a footnote definition (Muya writes the continuation indented, and a definition of several paragraphs is still moved to the end); Enter in a setext heading makes two headings, as in an atx one (the second line of marks is more than the edit's size); Ctrl+Shift+Left selecting across a link's or a bold word's marks (the browser selects the hidden source); a table cell after a paste into it (the matrix: the next cell starts from the pasted text); Backspace at a list item start in source mode (taken as writing). Take a cell out once it passes (the run says which).
